builds.title: Galehook, Roc Barbarian 1
builds.senses: Passive Perception 13, or 18 for sight. Advantage on sight-based Perception checks.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. Unarmored. Natural armor gives 15 AC. Barbarian Unarmored Defense would give 14 AC.
Counts as Large for carrying and lifting. Cannot use hand-held equipment, shields, or weapons.
actions: Talons. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 piercing, or 1d8 + 5 while raging.

Rage. Bonus action, 2 per long rest, up to 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage to Strength-based melee attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Ends early if knocked unconscious or if the turn ends without an attack against a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can also end it as a bonus action. Cannot cast or concentrate while raging.
builds.tactics: Galehook circles above the trail before landing to parley. If attacked, Galehook rages and strikes from a clear approach. Leaving an enemy’s reach still provokes normally.
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. No assigned CR.

builds.title: Lintel, Roper Barbarian 1
builds.languages: Understands and reads Common. Uses gestures to answer.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. Natural armor 15 + Dexterity 1. No hands.
After a motionless minute concentrating, Lintel passes for a stalagmite. Rage ends the concentration if the minute is still in progress.

Up to six tendrils, each AC 20 and 10 HP with poison and psychic immunity. A creature can spend its action breaking one with a DC 12 Strength check. Destruction leaves Lintel unharmed. Regrow one as a bonus action.
actions: Bite. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 piercing, or 1d8 + 5 while raging.

Grasping Tendrils. Replace the Attack action’s single attack with a grapple at up to 50 ft. against a creature no more than one size larger. Contest Athletics +5 against the target’s Athletics or Acrobatics. The grapple ends when separation exceeds 50 ft. or the gripping tendril is destroyed.

Reel. Replace the Attack action’s single attack. Roll Athletics +5 once against Athletics from each tendril-grappled creature. Pull each one Lintel beats up to 25 ft. directly closer. Spend a bonus action for one bite against a pulled creature within 5 ft.

Rage. Bonus action, 2 per long rest, up to 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 Strength melee damage, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Ends on unconsciousness or when a turn passes without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can end it as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Lintel holds a narrow ledge and separates intruders from the ladder. Start with a grasp, reel on a later turn, and bite only when the target reaches the mouth.
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. No assigned CR.

builds.title: Tatter Reed, Scarecrow Rogue 1
builds.languages: Understands, reads, and writes Common and Halfling. Cannot speak.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +3. Leather armor AC 11 + Dexterity 3. Expertise in Stealth and thieves’ tools.
Fire vulnerability. Immune to exhaustion, paralysis, poisoning, unconsciousness, and poison damage. Dies immediately at 0 HP under the supplement’s rule. Can recover by resting.
A motionless minute concentrating makes Tatter look like an ordinary scarecrow while it holds still.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn, add 1d6 to a hit with the rapier if Tatter has advantage, or if an enemy of the target that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of it and Tatter has no disadvantage.
actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 piercing.
Claw. Melee unarmed strike +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d4 − 1 slashing, minimum 0. This strike does not qualify for Sneak Attack.
Terrifying Gaze. Action, 1 per short or long rest. One mutually visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. Failure frightens it through the end of Tatter’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Tatter posts written warnings along the path. It opens with its gaze if a trespasser reaches for fire, then uses cover or an ally’s position to land a rapier strike.
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. No assigned CR.

builds.title: Slate Ward, Shield Guardian Fighter 1
builds.languages: Understands spoken commands in any language. Reads and writes Common. Cannot speak.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. AC 18 from its body plus 2 from the equipped shield. Dueling adds 2 damage to its one-handed mace.
Immune to charm, exhaustion, fear, and paralysis. Construct recovery by resting. Slate Ward has no controlling amulet.
actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d6 + 5 bludgeoning.
Fist. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 bludgeoning.
Second Wind. Bonus action, 1 per short or long rest. Regain 1d10 + 1 HP.
Shield. Reaction when an attacker targets an ally within 5 ft. of Slate Ward. The ally gains +2 AC against that attack.
builds.tactics: Slate Ward stays beside its ward, saves its reaction for an incoming attack against that person, and raises the shield to mark the way out.
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. No assigned CR.

builds.title: Lichen Mouth, Green Slaad Fighter 1
builds.languages: Slaad, Common, and Primordial. Telepathy 30 ft. with creatures that know a language.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +4, Constitution save +3. Leather AC 11 + Dexterity 2, plus 2 from the equipped shield. Keeps the claw hand free for casting.
Protection fighting style. When a creature Lichen Mouth can see attacks a target other than him within 5 ft. of him, he can use his reaction to impose disadvantage while wielding a shield.
Green variant. One fixed humanoid form and one true form. No darkvision or detect magic listed for this 1st-level Green build.
actions: Claw. In true form, melee unarmed strike +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d6 + 2 slashing.
Fire Bolt. Action, ranged spell attack +4 to hit against a creature or object within 120 ft. Hit for 1d10 fire. Unattended flammable objects can ignite.
Mage Hand. Action. Create a spectral hand within 30 ft. for 1 minute. Use an action to manipulate one object or carry up to 10 pounds. The hand cannot attack or activate magic items.
Shapechanger. Action. Become a specific Medium humanoid pottery seller or return to true form. No change to numbers in this Medium disguise. Equipment stays as it was. Death ends the disguise.
Second Wind. Bonus action, 1 per short or long rest. Regain 1d10 + 1 HP.
builds.tactics: Lichen Mouth tries to keep order in his pottery stall, uses the shield to cover a nearby customer, and moves away before throwing fire across an open space.
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. No assigned CR.

concepts.name: Galehook
concepts.motive: Retrieve the cairn markers a rockslide scattered across the valley.
concepts.hook: Galehook offers to spot a safe route from above in return for help recovering the markers.

concepts.name: Lintel
concepts.role: Keeper of an underground toll gate
concepts.motive: Keep the rope ladder steady and get travelers to repair the cracked approach.
concepts.hook: A tendril points from the buckled rock to an old maintenance diagram. Lintel will guide anyone who can restore the approach.

concepts.name: Tatter Reed
concepts.motive: Keep the apple cellar stocked for the farmhands who patched its ruined body.
concepts.hook: A chalk sign in Tatter’s hand asks the party to recover the harvest cart without burning the orchard.

concepts.name: Slate Ward
concepts.motive: Get the courier who removed its amulet across the abandoned canal locks.
concepts.hook: Slate Ward writes about a safe culvert entrance on its slate and asks the party to carry the courier’s heavy satchel.

concepts.name: Lichen Mouth
concepts.motive: Get back the clay tablet that lists his favorite glazes.
concepts.hook: The pottery seller drops the disguise when a thief flees with the tablet and recruits the party to help chase them.
